title: Primordial Paradox dialogue file
description: Every line the game can print, by dialogue id. A scene, a TALK command or a fight result names an id here. A long sentence may wrap; a single word longer than a 30 character line cannot, so that is what the line pattern refuses. Three pages of three lines is the box limit, so 9 lines is the cap. The 30 and 9 numbers mirror tools/check_data.py and tests/test_schemas.py compares them.

line.description: One line as typed into the box. No run of more than 30 non space characters, because the box wraps on spaces.

speaker.description: Who is talking, for the name plate. narrator is the no name case.
